name: 江佩穎
objective:
This course introduces the application of Hypertext Markup Language (HTML) syntax and Cascading Style Sheets (CSS). The course content includes:

Hypertext Markup Language
Cascading Style Sheets
JavaScript, an interpreted scripting language
HTML5 APIs syntax
CSS3 features
Scalable Vector Graphics (SVG)
HTML5 Canvas Application Programming Interface (API)
WebGL for three-dimensional rendering
FLASK framework
schedule:
Week1-3: Chapter1: Hypertext Markup Language
Week3-4: Chapter2: Cascading Style Sheets
Week5: Midterm Project
Week6-8: JavaScript, HTML Canvas
Week9-11: WebGL
Week11-15: Advanced Web programming topics
scorePolicy:
Homework Assignments: 20 %
2 Midterm Exams : 20% each
Final Exam: 30%
Quiz and Attendance: 10%
Bonus: 0.5 point

延伸教學與資源:
● 混成學習 (Blended Learning)
課程結合實體授課與線上學習（同步視訊／非同步活動）。
Combines face-to-face instruction with online learning (including synchronous video sessions or asynchronous activities).
● 數位科技融入 (Digital Technology Integration)
運用生成式 AI、VR/AR、IoT、IRS 等新興科技輔助教學與評量。
Utilizes emerging technologies such as Generative AI, VR/AR, IoT, and IRS (Interactive Response Systems) to facilitate teaching and assessment.
課程對應SDGs指標: SDG9：產業創新與基礎設施（Industry, Innovation and Infrastructure）
課程是否導入AI:
● 使用生成式 AI 作為教學過程的輔助工具（Use generative AI tools as an aid to the teaching process）
● 使用生成式 AI 進行課堂即時互動（Use generative AI for real-time classroom interaction）
